title: Architecture
description: A C4 Context + Container model derived from the project graph. Containers are the repository's own packages; relationships are dependency edges between them. Every element names the graph node or edge it came from, so a box on the diagram leads back to the extractor output that justified it — nothing is drawn that the graph does not contain. Component and Code level views are deliberately absent: they go stale on every commit, and a stale diagram is worse than none.

readability.description: The same mechanical rubric the map views are held to. A diagram that fails it is still emitted here — it is one box per package and there is no smaller honest view to fall back to — but the failure is stated so the reader knows what they are looking at.

key.description: Structurizr DSL identifier; stable for a given name.

level.description: Dependency level, computed by the same levelization the map uses, so the client lays containers out from data rather than from a layout algorithm nobody pinned.

evidenceNodeId.description: The project-graph node this container was derived from.

path.description: Manifest path, when the package has one — what a reader opens.

evidenceEdgeId.description: The project-graph edge this relationship was derived from.

weight.description: How many symbol-level edges back this dependency.
